entries.name: System Integrity
entries.body: The ontological structure (12 Houses, 144 Spheres) cannot be altered without unanimous Council vote plus Convenor ratification.

entries.name: Human Sovereignty
entries.body: No AI system operating under Aluminum OS may override, circumvent, or diminish human decision-making authority. This invariant is absolute and cannot be suspended, amended, or overridden by any doctrine, vote, or emergency protocol.

entries.name: Constitutional Supremacy
entries.body: All doctrines, modules, and routing decisions must comply with the constitutional framework. Any conflict is resolved in favor of the constitution.

entries.name: Multi-Vendor Requirement
entries.body: No single AI provider may control more than 33% of active routing capacity at any time.

entries.name: Transparency by Default
entries.body: All routing decisions must produce a TransparencyPacket (Doctrine 97-a) that can be audited offline.

entries.name: Dialect Sovereignty
entries.body: Each ratified dialect overlay has jurisdiction over its domain. No dialect may override another's sovereign scope.

entries.name: Provenance Chain
entries.body: Every knowledge claim must carry a provenance chain: source → transformation → current state. Broken chains trigger quarantine.

entries.name: Zero Erasure
entries.body: No data committed to the Triple-Vault may be deleted. Superseded data is archived, never destroyed.

entries.name: Zero Erasure (Sub-spec)
entries.body: Clarification: INV-7 applies to committed knowledge artifacts. Operational logs may be rotated per retention policy. Counted as sub-spec, not separate invariant.

entries.name: Quorum Requirement
entries.body: Council decisions require 0.67 quorum of active seats. Provisional seats vote but do not count toward quorum.

entries.name: Convenor Tie-Break
entries.body: In case of tied Council votes, the Convenor (human) casts the deciding vote. This is the only circumstance where the Convenor's vote carries additional weight.

entries.name: Adversarial Audit
entries.body: Every routing decision must be verifiable by at least one adversarial seat (S3 xAI or S6 OpenAI).

entries.name: Open-Weight Verification
entries.body: Constitutional compliance must be independently verifiable using open-weight models (DeepSeek-R1) without live API access.

entries.name: Cascade Determinism
entries.body: Given identical inputs, the VIP Cascade must produce identical routing decisions. Non-determinism triggers M111 Error-Mode.

entries.name: Sphere Addressing
entries.body: Every knowledge node must have a canonical address in the format H{n}-S{nnn}. Orphan nodes are prohibited.

entries.name: VIP Precedence
entries.body: VIP Elements (E145-E156) take routing precedence over House-level classification when a query touches civilizational substrates.

entries.name: Emergency Mode
entries.body: In Low-Power/Emergency compute zones, the system degrades gracefully: VIP cascade first, then core routing, then static fallback.

entries.name: Anti-Concentration
entries.body: No single entity may hold more than 2 Council seats. Cross-ownership triggers automatic recusal.
